title: Proactive Context-Forecasted Safety Constraints for Nonstationary Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.08080v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ensuring safety in reinforcement learning under nonstationarity requires anticipating changes in risk before they lead to unsafe behavior. Existing approaches typically rely on safety constraints defined at design time or updated reactively during execution, assuming that such constraints remain valid over time. However, in nonstationary environments with evolving contexts and changing driving layouts, these assumptions may fail.   We propose a framework for proactive safety constraint generation based on context forecasting. The approach infers latent environmental context from observations, predicts its future evolution, and constructs safety constraints adapted to anticipated conditions. This enables the agent to proactively avoid unsafe regions instead of reacting only after safety violations occur.   We evaluate the method in driving environments with structured context variation. The experiments include a sweep over nonstationarity

translated_title: 面向非平稳强化学习的主动式情境预测安全约束
translated_abstract: 在非平稳环境下确保强化学习的安全性，需要在风险导致不安全行为之前预先察觉这些变化。现有方法通常依赖于在设计阶段定义的安全约束，或在执行过程中被动更新的约束，并假设此类约束会随时间保持有效。然而，在具有演变情境和变化驾驶布局的非平稳环境中，这些假设可能失效。我们提出了一个基于情境预测的主动式安全约束生成框架。该方法从观测中推断潜在的环境情境，预测其未来演变，并构建适应预期条件的安全约束。这使智能体能够主动避免不安全区域，而不是仅在安全违规发生后才做出反应。我们在具有结构化情境变化的驾驶环境中对该方法进行评估，实验包括对非平稳性的参数扫描。
tldr: 提出了一种基于情境预测的主动式安全约束生成框架，通过推断潜在环境情境并预测其未来演变来前瞻性地构建安全约束，使强化学习智能体能够在非平稳环境中主动规避不安全区域。
en_tdlr: A proactive safety constraint generation framework that infers latent environmental contexts and forecasts their future evolution, enabling RL agents to anticipate and avoid unsafe regions in nonstationary environments.
